<js>
var result = [];


var statusMap = {
    "全部": "",
    "全本": "/quanben/"
};

var statusType = infoMap["状态"] || "全部";
var statusParam = statusMap[statusType];
result.push({
    "title": "状态",
    "type": "select",
    "chars": ["全部","全本"],
    "default": statusType,
    "action": "java.refreshExplore()",
    "style": {"layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 1}
});
result.push({
        "title":statusType,
        "url":`${statusParam}/sort/{{page}}/`,
        "style":{"layout_flexGrow":1,"layout_flexBasisPercent":1}
    });

var koreanItems = ['奇幻','武侠','都市','科幻','历史','耽美','游戏','其他','午夜',];

for(var i=0;i<koreanItems.length;i++){
    result.push({
        "title":koreanItems[i],
        "url":`${statusParam}/sort/${i+1}/{{page}}/`,
        "style":{"layout_flexGrow":1,"layout_flexBasisPercent":0.25}
    });
}

// 输出 JSON 字符串
JSON.stringify(result);
</js>
